embeds.title: Day 9 shipped — Shift Lobby · Tier 2 is now reachable
embeds.description: The world boots into a lobby instead of auto-arming Tier 1. Pick **T1 qc_tier1_001** for the relaxed warmup or **T2 qc_tier2_001** for the multi-unit-heavy structure-fire run. End-of-shift summary now offers **Restart** (re-arm same shift) or **Return to Lobby** (pick a different one). Day 8's Tier 2 shift is finally playable.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 81/81 tests · vite 11s · 531 KB gz

fields.name: ShiftLobby panel
fields.value: Centred modal over dimmed map. Each shift gets a tier chip (emerald T1 · amber T2-3 · crimson T4-5), notes preview, incident-type pill row, and a `start →` affordance. Player click = `loadShift(...)` → status flips `idle` → `running` → spawn timeline starts.

fields.name: Four new palette verbs
fields.value:
`start <shift>` — arm a shift from the lobby (with shift-id autocomplete)
`restart` — re-arm current shift definition, clears incidents_spawned
`end_shift` — force end-of-shift; computes outcome on the spot
`lobby` — drop the current shift, reset roster to homebases

fields.name: New `shift` slot kind in palette
fields.value: Typing `start ` (Tab) now suggests every available_shift with trailing context: `tier 1 · 12 min · 5 inc`. Slot-aware filtering — no more rememberin' the shift id.

fields.name: Return-to-Lobby reset
fields.value: When the player exits a finished shift, every unit gets reset to its boot-time homebase coord with `status: available`, no road-graph reroute (this is a between-shifts state, not a sim event). Lobby reappears, available_shifts preserved, ready for another run.

fields.name: ShiftSummary footer revamp
fields.value: Old single Close button → two buttons: **Restart** (re-arms same shift, fresh game_min) and **Return to Lobby** (full reset). Esc still hides the modal without resetting state — same as before.

fields.name: Tests
fields.value: **81/81 pass** · 12 new lobby tests: boot-to-idle, start arms correct shift, start rejects unknown id, start rejects when running, restart clears spawned set, restart no-op without shift, end_shift completes + scores, end_shift rejects when idle, lobby resets roster, available_shifts preserved across reset, shift-slot suggestions list/filter.

fields.name: Day 10 menu
fields.value: (a) **multi-station roster** + agency-aware closest-unit dispatch · (b) save/replay verbs (Dexie) · (c) full QC bbox tile-and-merge (Overpass scrape) · (d) more shifts (Tier 3, narrative arcs).
